n-french-protests.title: French protest coins
n-french-protests.summary: Coins named for the French protests of 2026-10-17. Le Monde and the BBC report that nationwide cost-of-living protests on 2026-10-17 turned to clashes, looting and arson in Paris and other cities (800,000 marchers by the organizers' count, 550,000 by the interior minister's; about 1,800 arrests), and that President Macron addressed the nation on 2026-10-18 (e3:1, e3:2). Three pump.fun coins on Solana carry the story: The French Doomsday (Doomsday), whose metadata reads "Avengers-level protests in France, live and unhinged", and two contracts named French Goku Hero (PIERRE), whose metadata is empty. Trader and scanner posts of 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-19 call French Goku Hero a French internet figure from the riots and one relays a claim that he posted about a looted shop in Nice on 2026-10-17 (e2:1); a post of 2026-10-19 says his own coin is a different contract, so which PIERRE contract, if any, is the intended one is unclear (e2:1). All three pools were created on 2026-10-18, 8 to 14 hours before discovery, and most posts about the coins are call-group promotion. These are traders' and the coins' own claims: nothing seen links the coins to the people or events reported. Measured: three coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI; a 2026-10-15 post reports that the task force is due to hold its first meeting (e1:5). Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, and two BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11, and a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename). Two coins named Tetsuo Super Intelligence (TSI; Clanker on Robinhood Chain and pump.fun on Solana) joined on 2026-10-18, with pools 2.8 and 4.6 hours old at discovery: traders' posts call TSI "another SI coin" and one says Elon Musk posted about it (e2:0), which is unverified. SPACEXSI and Ollie (pump.fun) left on 2026-10-17, and SIGF (pump.fun) and SuperHooks (Pons) on 2026-10-18, after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink (SXSITBL, pump.fun) joined on 2026-10-19: its name combines SpaceXSI with Tesla and Boring, its pool was created 2.2 hours before discovery, and nothing seen ties it to the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI or TSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: fifteen coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-flying-tesla-roadster: Coins named for the Tesla Roadster unveiling. Posts dated 2026-10-16 describe Tesla showing a next-generation Roadster with SpaceX cold-gas thrusters at SpaceX's Texas test site on the evening of 2026-10-15: it drove up a ramp, flipped in the air and landed, with a claimed 0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds and deliveries in 2028 (@niccruzpatane, @cb_doge); DEXTools quotes Tesla's "Real life, baby" caption and Elon Musk's reply "Turns out the future does have flying cars". Seven coins carry the name: two FTR contracts on Solana's pump.fun (Flying Tesla Roadster, and "Farting Tesla Roadster", whose metadata says "Everyone came for the movie"), a 特斯拉能飞 ("flying tesla roadster") coin on BNB Chain (Flap), a second Flying Tesla Roadster (FTR) on Flap, Starman (STARMAN, "the driver of the flying Tesla Roadster") Roadster (Flap), whose Chinese metadata refers to Musk and Tesla's new sports car and carries a QQ contact number, and, since 2026-10-19, Flying Tesla Dogester (DOGESTER, pump.fun), whose metadata says "Doge just learned to fly" (pool created 2026-10-18, after the unveiling). Posts of 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-19 announce FTR spot listings on KCEX, LBank and KuCoin Alpha (e1:3). The Meteora DBC FTR contracts left on 2026-10-17 and the Clanker 特斯拉能飞 on Robinhood Chain on 2026-10-18 after 24h pool volume under $1,000. The main pump.fun FTR says it pairs with $SPCX and $TSLA through OTC desks; its pool was created on 2026-10-15 at 02:08 UTC, before the unveiling, as was the Flap Roadster pool (04:28 UTC), while the other pools were created after it. An older FTR on StonkFun, created in August, predates the story and is not included, and a further pump.fun FTR is quarantined for an implausible market cap and extreme 24h move. These are traders' and the coins' own claims: no coin is shown to be affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk, most are days old, and the story is a single event. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-perpetual-futures: Coins whose metadata describes perpetual-futures trading. Papertrade's site (papertrade.xyz, e1:1) says "1000x leverage, 0 market impact, 100% user owned, fully onchain on hyperliquid", and @papertrade_xyz posted that trading was expected to start at 14:00 UTC on 2026-10-10. Four coins named Paper (Papertrade) copy its tagline: two new Clanker contracts, on Base (pool created 2026-10-18 11:21 UTC) and on Robinhood Chain (pool created 2026-10-19 02:26 UTC), which carry nearly all of the narrative's volume, and an earlier Base Clanker contract (pool created 2026-10-17) and Robinhood Clanker contract that traded almost nothing in the last 24 hours after tens of millions the day before. The sources seen never name any of these contracts. Posts of 2026-10-18 say PAPER is trading as a pre-launch perpetual on Hyperliquid listed by Paragon and that the token cannot yet be moved between wallets (e1:7, e2:0), so affiliation of the on-chain Paper copies with Papertrade is not verified. EmpireX (EMPIREX, Pons, Robinhood Chain) says it is a perpetual trading hub powered by Hyperliquid, and @HyperEmpireX introduced it on 2026-10-16. Purps (PURPS, Meteora DBC) says it launches perp-backed tokens. Aloooong (pump.fun) calls itself the "First 10x PUMP long perpetual meme". These are the projects' and traders' own claims: revenue, leverage, payouts and affiliation among the coins are not verified. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.

n-super-intelligence.notice: The White House SIF and SpaceXSI posts still date from 2026-10-04 (e1:5); a 2026-10-15 post reports the task force's first meeting is due (e1:5), and the newest $SI and TSI posts (2026-10-09 to 2026-10-18, e1:2) come from traders. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink joined; no coin left.
n-super-intelligence.interpretation: The rename story is real but more than two weeks old and the coins keep fading: the twelve older coins together traded about $3.2M in the 24 hours to 04:00 UTC (about $2.9M in the prior run's window), while the two Tetsuo Super Intelligence coins traded about $1.7M against about $13.2M in the prior window, 34% of the narrative's $5.0M, with the Solana one still over 10x its market cap. The Robinhood Chain TSI traded $277 in the window after about $8.3M the day before and will leave if it stays under $1,000. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink added $0.11M from a pool about 2 hours old at discovery. None of the coins is shown to be affiliated with the announcements.

n-flying-tesla-roadster.notice: Posts of 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-19 (e1:3) are promotion, trader tallies and exchange listing notices: KCEX and LBank listed FTR on 2026-10-16 and a KuCoin Alpha listing was reported on 2026-10-19. Flying Tesla Dogester joined after passing the bars.
n-flying-tesla-roadster.interpretation: The unveiling is real and dated (2026-10-15), but this is one news event and demand for the copies keeps fading: 24h volume across the seven coins is $6.0M against $7.9M in the prior run's window, with the two pump.fun FTR contracts carrying 88% of it and Flying Tesla Dogester adding $0.28M. None of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk.

n-perpetual-futures.notice: Posts of 2026-10-18 (e1:7, e2:0) say PAPER perps began trading on Hyperliquid through Paragon, as a pre-launch market, and that the token cannot yet be moved between wallets; Papertrade's site (e1:1) is unchanged. Two new Paper contracts appeared (Base and Robinhood Chain) while the Paper contract that traded about $54M yesterday traded almost nothing in 24 hours. EmpireX, Purps and Aloooong are unchanged.
n-perpetual-futures.interpretation: Perpetual-futures venues are a real, dated theme, but the Paper coins are copy contracts that come and go within a day or two: volume moved again, from the Base contract that carried about $55M a day earlier ($25 now) to two new contracts, Base ($42.5M, about 4x its market cap) and Robinhood Chain ($13.2M, its pool created 1.6 hours before the chart window closed), together 98% of the narrative's $56.6M. Nothing seen links any of them to Papertrade. Treat the volume as young-pool trading.
